sources.known_gaps: The dated entries currently available in the official Claude app release notes, including model and plan announcements listed there. This endpoint currently starts in August 2025; it is not Claude's launch date. Claude Code has a separate history.

English US Gemini Apps release notes available from the official page, including its historical Bard entries. Regional availability can differ. Gemini CLI and the developer API have separate release histories.

The official DeepSeek API change log, including model availability, API behavior and pricing. Web and mobile changes appear only when explicitly included in the API announcement; this is not a complete consumer-app history. Benchmark tables and code examples are excluded.

Every dated entry listed in the official changelog index, including voice, audio, agent and API updates. The default Markdown page contains only a recent window, so collection traverses the complete index. Documentation widgets and code examples are excluded.
Dated entries available in Lovable's official product changelog. Undated help articles, hosting widgets and code examples are excluded; endpoint coverage is not proof of lifetime coverage.
Dated v0 product announcements available on the official changelog. This does not include the wider Vercel platform's changelog or undated documentation updates.
Stable versioned releases of the Ollama application and runtime. Prereleases and model-library updates without a corresponding application release are excluded.
Stable versioned releases of Dify's open-source platform. Cloud-only changes, separately versioned plugins and prereleases have separate histories.
Stable versioned Open WebUI releases from the official repository. Development builds, prereleases and external model-provider updates are excluded.

Dated weekly Replit changelog pages listed in the official sitemap, covering Agent and related development-platform features. This includes non-AI platform changes announced alongside Agent. Unindexed historical announcements are outside this source's scope.
